import { ref, computed } from 'vue';

// reactive counter
const count = ref(0);
const doubled = computed(() => count.value * 2);

function increment() {
  count.value++;
}
</script>

<template>
  <button class="counter" @click="increment">
    Count is {{ count }} ({{ doubled }})
  </button>
</template>
